description: Unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser class, verifying parsing of JSON directives in speech-related functionality within the ai.openclaw.app.voice package.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParserTest
classes.description: Test suite verifying the parsing logic of the TalkDirectiveParser class, including handling of directives, unknown keys, alternate keys, and null directives.

methods.name: parsesDirectiveAndStripsHeader
methods.description: Test that a JSON directive with 'voice' and 'once' keys is parsed correctly, extracting relevant fields and stripping headers.

methods.name: ignoresUnknownKeysButReportsThem
methods.description: Test that unknown JSON keys are ignored but reported in the result's unknownKeys list.

methods.name: parsesAlternateKeys
methods.description: Test that alternate directive keys ('model_id', 'similarity_boost', etc.) are parsed properly into the expected fields.

methods.name: returnsNullWhenNoDirectivePresent
methods.description: Test that an empty JSON object results in a null directive with preserved stripped input.
